faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex measure?
faqs.answer: This test determines the drug susceptibility of the MTb complex to isoniazid.

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex done?
faqs.answer: • To determine if the bacteria causing TB are resistant or sensitive to isoniazid. • To guide doctors in prescribing appropriate treatment plans for patients with TB. • To minimise the risk of drug resistance by selecting effective medications. • To monitor and evaluate treatment effectiveness and make necessary adjustments.

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test may be recommended if you • Have been diagnosed with TB and need to determine drug susceptibility. • Require a change in your TB medication due to treatment failure or drug resistance. • Are at high risk of developing drug-resistant TB. • Have been exposed to someone with drug-resistant TB. • Have recurrent or persistent symptoms of TB despite receiving treatment.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results suggest that the bacteria causing TB may be resistant to isoniazid.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside this test include: • AFB smear microscopy: This test helps identify the presence of acid-fast bacilli (AFB) in sputum or other specimens. • Xpert MTB/RIF assay: This molecular test detects the presence of TB bacteria and checks for rifampicin resistance.

faqs.question: What is the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Isoniazid Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex also known as?
faqs.answer: Isoniazid susceptibility test for the MTb complex

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease caused by the bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. TB spreads through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Common symptoms include persistent cough, weight loss, fatigue, and night sweats. Early diagnosis and appropriate treatment are crucial for managing TB effectively.
